metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise that can quickly help forward head posture.

A big reason for forward head posture is due to tight muscles that draw everything forward (anterior). This exercise will focus on loosening up these tight muscles, and may quickly improve posture within 30 seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
